title: Whose, and Who To
label: ch:ur-whose-and-who-to
canDo: I can say whose something is for any person, mark when the owner is also the subject, invite agreement, and call somebody.

payoff.summary: The possessive column fills from two of six to five of six, and اپنا adds a distinction English has not got at all -- his own room against somebody else's -- which Urdu requires and a learner cannot skip.
payoff.note: The tag ہے نا؟ introduces no new vocabulary: both halves have been in the book since chapters two and nineteen and nobody had put them together.
